name: Al Hayba
description: In a village by the Lebanon-Syria border, the head of an arms-smuggling clan contends with family conflicts, power struggles and complicated love.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Alia arrives in Lebanon to bring her late husband’s body to his estranged family. She knows nothing about them, and things immediately seem strange.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's been a week since the funeral, and Alia is increasingly on edge. Bodyguards are with her constantly and the family is clearly hiding something.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Despite being forced to extend her stay, Alia is determined to return to Canada with her son. Cautiously, she begins to open up to Jabal.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Naim informs Alia that Jabal is involved in major criminal activity. Nahed refuses to allow Alia to leave for Beirut with Joe.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jabal's henchman Debb is arrested on homicide charges. Alia meets Majdi, Mona's estranged husband, and learns something disturbing about Adel.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Alia is distraught to learn the details of the family business. She doesn't want this life for herself or her son, but Nahed refuses to let them go.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The fight between Nidal and Sakher escalates to a tense standoff between families. Jabal tries to stop Alia when he finds out she's run away with Joe.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: After her attempted escape, Alia is given an ultimatum: stay with her son and become a part of the family, or return to Canada alone.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Alia steels herself for a tough legal battle to get her son back. Jabal tracks down Naim and makes sure he'll never help Alia again.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The lawyer Majdi recommends seems very capable, but Alia has reservations about his fee. Chahine visits his father in prison.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Chahine is torn between his father and his loyalty to Jabal. Joe starts to really miss his mother. After meeting with her lawyer, Alia is optimistic.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mona begins to receive texts from her estranged husband. Nidal confronts Alia. Jabal refuses to allow Joe to see Alia. Debb gets released on bail.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Just as things are looking up with Alia's court case, Jabal meets and threatens Alia's lawyer. Ghada's daughter wants to move back in with her.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Mona is forced out of the family home for attempting to reunite Joe with his mother. With her lawyer turning on her, Alia is now truly out of options.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Nahed tries to prevent Alia from renting a place anywhere in Al Hayba, thereby forcing Alia to move in with the family under the matriarch's terms.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: After holding her son in her arms again, Alia makes her decision: She will marry Jabal, but she makes it clear that she won't be a submissive wife.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Ghada is upset that Jabal has married another woman. Despite chafing under her restrictive new life, Alia proves her capability in the kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Alia wants Jabal to make it clear to his mother that their marriage is just an arrangement of convenience. Alia is secretly still planning an escape.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Knowing how bored she is at home, Jabal gets Alia a job running their family-owned yogurt factory. Chahine falls deeper in with Dorayd and Zidan.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: After hearing from Chahine that Dorayd needs more time to find Ronny, Jabal gives him 10 more days -- or else. Alia and Jabal begin to grow closer.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ghada is shocked to see Alia walk into her clinic for a checkup. A capable engineer named Amal interviews for a position at the factory.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: While intercepting one of Zidan's cars, Jabal finds a frightened young woman named Hanady and brings her home. Alia takes her under her wing.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Hanady must decide to either stay or return to Zidan. Jabal deals with Dorayd. Alia and Joe are caught in the crossfire in an ambush targeting Jabal.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Jabal explains how he's been one step ahead of Dorayd this whole time. After Mona suffers a devastating loss, Alia rushes to Beirut to console her.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: To cheer Mona up, Nahed comes to Beirut with Joe. Jabal tells Ghada that he can't go to her place anymore. Alia goes forward with her escape plan.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Mona tells Majdi that she wants a divorce. Chahine is transferred to a prison cell with his father. Jabal and Alia have an emotional confrontation.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After Alia gives Ghada a piece of her mind, Ghada crosses the line and goes to Jabal's family home. Jabal agrees to be tested for fertility issues.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: While getting ready for a date with Jabal, Alia tells Mona that yes, she has feelings for her husband. Sakher pays Rima's blackmailer a visit.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: It's Joe's birthday. Chahine is cornered into betraying Jabal, and the family home is raided by the police. Nidal is still thirsty for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: The women of the house are heartbroken to see what happened to Sakher. Jabal publicly punishes Nidal. Alia is told she is free to go if she chooses.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: ِAdel pays Jabal a visit in prison, leading to a charged conversation and a trip down a turbulent memory lane.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the Sheikh Al-Jabal family prepares for a high-security, festive occasion, grave danger looms.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While Ghazi and Jamal deal with a crisis, the family scrambles with limited resources to save one of their own.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The family grapples with a new difficult reality, and a furious Jabal swears vengeance. Jamal is presented with a tempting yet questionable offer.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Adel's impulsive action leads to tense clashes with the Al-Said family and Jabal is left to deal with the bloody conflict.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: To put an end to the tribal feud, Jabal proposes a shocking settlement affecting Somaya, Nidal and Mariam. Chahine and Mona's relationship is tested.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Looking for answers, Mona confronts her uncle. A distraught Mariam is forced to make a tough decision.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Two years later, the Al-Said family gets ready to celebrate a happy occasion despite instability in Al Hayba. Somaya decides to break her silence.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A successful jailbreak brings back a key player to Al Hayba, disrupting many agendas.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Nazem pays Sheikh Al-Jabal's family a visit with a proposition in mind. Mona shares her wisdom with Somaya.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Jabal's trusted sources fill him in on what went down in his absence, and Sakher struggles to get back on his feet.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Hoping to mend fences, Jabal reaches out to his estranged cousin, Chahine. A tense lunch meeting leaves Mona conflicted.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Looking for answers about the shady deliveries coming from Nazem, Chahine pays his father, Ghazi, a visit in prison.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jabal receives an anonymous threat. At home, Sakher starts to improve and Somaya is furious after one of her precious belongings goes missing.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Jabal gives Nidal and Somaya a stern warning. After declining to cooperate in a smuggling operation, Chahine is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Jabal and Sakher join forces to execute a necessary operation, which, in turn, gives Nazem a serious ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Following a heated confrontation, Nidal swears revenge. Somaya starts to warm up to her in-laws, as Jabal sets out to restore order in the village.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Chahine regrets letting Mona go and desperately reaches out to her hoping it's not too late. Nazem pays Nahed a surprise visit.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: When conflict erupts, Somaya intercedes in Nahed's defense. With strict conditions, Jabal gives Majdi the green light.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Mona and Majdi tie the knot, Nazem runs for parliament hoping to maximize his influence, and Sakher refuses to let go of his feelings for Rima.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A surprise proposal leaves Salma infuriated. Nahed advises Jabal to focus on his relationship with Somaya instead of dwelling on the past.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Nazem's election campaign is off to a rocky start. Tensions rise between newlyweds Mona and Majdi. Jabal uncovers a clue in an old family photo album.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Rola steps up to save Salma, sacrificing her own happiness. Somaya runs a private errand, and Chahine investigates a cold case.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Chahine's investigation lands him a major discovery. Al Hayba's mayor reaches out to Jabal for help following a grand robbery.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Majdi crosses the line with Mona and he is left to deal with the dire repercussions. A defeated Marwa finally finds a glimmer of hope.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Furious about Sakher's intervention, Mona confronts her family. Marwa and Eyad embark on a dangerous mission that spirals out of control.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: On election day, Al Hayba turns into a ghost town. A sore loser retaliates, turning the silence into a full-blown clash.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: After a night of terror, Nahed decides to take matters into her own hands. A development within Nazem's household makes things unbearable for Salma.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Somaya struggles to deal with the consequences of her deep secret being exposed. Jabal and his men receive an alarming tip.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Nazem feels the heat and arranges for his daughters to escape. Chahine's investigation leads to a shocking discovery and a painful realization.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Abu Ali recalls the tragic incident that led to Jabal temporarily relocating from Al Hayba to Beirut.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: An emergency admission makes the hospital a risky place for Jabal. Nour decides to tackle a controversial file on her talk show.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jabal learns more about his new neighbor. Sakher gets into a fight — but it's stopped by the sudden appearance of a blast from the past.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Nour unwittingly drags Jabal into her drama. At home, Nahed and Mona get into a heated argument about Chahine.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jamal tries to convince Jabal to rethink his choices. Ali feels conflicted after Sakher shares a dangerous secret with him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The prison goes on high alert after tragic news reaches Ghazi. Nahed turns to Jabal when Mona and Sakher both defy her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A chance encounter prompts Nour to pick up a dropped story. At the hospital, a patient's surprise recovery leads to a tough confrontation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Nour and Jabal's relationship develops. Sakher is prepped for a major operation. Meanwhile, the police receive a hot tip.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: News breaks out about Jabal, devastating Nour and putting her in a difficult position. Tharwat gets suspicious.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Chahine reaches out to an old friend. Ali intervenes to keep business matters in order as Zeidan and his men continue to pressure Jabal.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Nour desperately waits for a sign from Jabal. Abu Ali and Al Shayeb decide not to share bad news with Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Chahine gets offered a fresh start. Meanwhile, Jabal's plan to escape is staggered by an anonymous tip.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Hana introduces Sami to Ghazi as a loyal ally. Eager to meet with Jabal, Nour steps into real danger.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Nour pressures Jabal for answers, which devastate her. Tharwat gets personally involved in the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: As Jabal and his family attempt a risky escape, unexpected help shows up to rescue them from imminent danger. Nahed refuses to rethink her decision.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Nour deals with the challenging repercussions of her choice. A conflict of interest causes a rift between Jabal and Jamal.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Tharwat conspires to tarnish Nour's reputation. Sakher loses his temper after learning Rima's news. Mona searches relentlessly for her missing true love.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Broken-hearted, Nour turns down a proposal. An estranged Sheikh Al-Jabal family member makes a surprise return to Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Ghazi sets out to avenge his son, but an unexpected appearance sets the record straight. Nour’s travel plans are disrupted.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Ghazi realizes that he has a debt to repay. Mona gives Chahine an ultimatum. Tharwat’s right-hand man reaches out to Jabal.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Jabal calls an emergency meeting with a big announcement underway. Chahine and Abu Issa's visit to Sultan's house leaves the family conflicted.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: A culture clash between Jabal and Nour causes some issues. Chahine and Mona finally get good news, and Ghazi rethinks how the business should run.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Nour tries to adjust to her new life, while Mona prepares for her upcoming occasion. Ghazi's attempts to expand his business affect Jabal's interests.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Ghazi monopolizes the only road leading to Al Hayba, putting Chahine in a difficult position. Jabal studies his next move.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Sakher eagerly reaches out to Rima hoping to change her mind. Al Hayba struggles financially, and Jamal reveals some shocking news to Jabal and Nahed.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jamal calls Nahed's attention to hidden details. Jabal and Nour are pressured into making a tough decision.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Jabal decides to take matters into his own hands, surprising everyone. A common goal brings about an unexpected alliance.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Al Hayba's situation worsens as the disruptive alliance gains more power. Rima shares some shocking news with Mona and Chahine.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Jabal's gesture is well received by Al Hayba's residents, angering Ghazi. Tharwat gives his final ultimatum. A whistleblower leaks a dangerous plot.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Following the dreadful news, Jabal feels betrayed and carefully plans a fierce retaliation.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Following the ambush, Jabal hits rock bottom. As the power struggle in Al Hayba continues, the stakes are high as he seeks to punish those who did him wrong.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Nimr Al Saeed’s arrival in Al Hayba gives the people a ray of hope. Jabal, however, feels threatened and stands on the guard.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jabal discovers a contraband that’s been smuggled to Al Hayba. Nimr gets attacked, as Rania, Jamal's daughter, appears at Jabal’s doorstep.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Nimr offers to buy the yogurt factory. Rania cries out for Jabal’s mum’s help. Ali plots to break out of prison with Jabal’s help.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jabal frees the Al Taffar prisoner and returns the contraband to Shahin. Nimr continues pressuring the Sheikh Al Jabal’s to sell him the factory.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Much to everyone’s surprise, Jabal returns home. Preventing his family from selling the factory, Jabal leaves Nimr dismayed.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: "Jabal’s mum senses his urge to seek revenge. Rania treats Jabal with kindness. Ali prepares to escape.; "

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jabal gets busy welcoming guests as Nimr is left home alone. Having found out about Ali’s escape from prison, Shahin loses his temper.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Rania and Nimr meet in secret to reassess their malicious plans to con the Sheikh Al Jabals.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Nimr opens up a butchery at the town center. Rania bonds with the family. Mona accepts Um Shahins conditions to get her son back.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Jabal and Nimr go on a tour to the yogurt factory. Shahin arrives in town and has something planned for Ali.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jabal reveals to his mother the reasons behind Nimr’s desire to acquire the factory. Later, Al Mokhtar and Shahin learn about Nimr’s actual story.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Shahin has a near-death experience as everyone keeps a close eye on Ali.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As Al Tabbakh heads to the captagon factory, he crosses path with Jabal. Ali goes to Jabal’s house and makes a strange request.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Shahin keeps a close eye on Ali’s wedding celebration. Jabal and Nimr partner up to reopen the factory. Sakher packs up and prepares to leave.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sakher decides to camp in the forest for a few days. Elsewhere, Shahin hits rock bottom and decides to stay away from the house.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: People of Al Hayba invest their money with Nimr. Jabal buys the Captagon shipment. Someone sneaks into Jabal’s house.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: When Rania redecorates his room, Jabal blows a fuse. Later, he keeps a close eye on Nimr and his latest plan.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The past brings Jabal and Rania closer. Mona returns to Um Shahin’s house. Nimr thinks he has beaten Jabal.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: When Nimr exposes a kept secret, the police lay their hands on half of the Captagon shipment.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Jabal and his men get arrested for smuggling drugs. Nimr, meanwhile, rides roughshod over the agreement leading to division between the towners.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Rania comes face to face with her father’s murderer. Nimr seeks to lay his hands on the explosives while Jabal proceeds with the mine clearance.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Jabal is extremely anxious when his mother falls ill. Al Shayeb vanishes into thin air.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: While Jabal attempts to intersect the third contraband, Shahin tries to dispose of Al Taffar. Nimr has a shocking surprise in store for his enemies.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Nimr manages to pull off his scheme while Jabal wages war on him. Noor pays Nimr a visit to deliver Zaidan’s message.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jabal and his men continue their fierce raids, this time targeting Shahin’s store and Nimr’s house. Later, Jabal’s mother uncovers a shocking truth about Rania.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: On a special occasion, Ali and Shahin find themselves sharing the same table. Nimr takes another hostage and his demands provoke Jabal’s mother.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Al Mukhtar finds himself in a predicament. Nimr shows his true colours to the towners and wages war on everyone.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Everyone tries to locate Nimr’s den. Meanwhile, Nimr gives the Al Hayba people an unbelievable ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: While his conflict with Nimr grows fierce, Jabal must make tough calls and think of a way to deliver the final blow.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As news of a murder spreads in the community, a devastated Jabal must pull himself together to identify those involved and decide on a course of action.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Planning to deliver his first blow, Jabal takes the battle to Beirut while Shahin assumes control of Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jabal identifies the suspects, unaware that his life is on the line. Later, an unlikely person’s involvement in the murder pits Al Hayba against another tribe.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Jabal and his men prepare to attack the villa, Shahin tries to control an act of rebellion in Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Now that he took his revenge, Jabal is caught between a rock and a hard place. Meanwhile, the tension between Ali and Shahin boils over.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The police raid Al Hayba in search of Jabal, who tries to mend fences between Shahin and Ali. Later, Ali vows to retaliate against those who harmed his father.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: As the search for Jabal continues, Shahin is rebuked for his actions, and attempts are made to ease the rising tensions between the two rival tribes.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Having rescued Sarah, Jabal and his men set out to reclaim her belongings from Sameeh. Wadee’ tries to get closer to Shahin, unaware that a surprise awaits him.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Sarah tells Jabal her story as Mona prepares to welcome her. Wadee’ receives another message while Jabal begins to worry about the dam’s concealed operations.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Tensions rise between Ali and Shahin over Rima. While Sarah hides something unexpected, Jabal plans to uncover the truth about the dam.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The dam becomes Wadee’s station for smuggling. While touring the field together, Jabal makes it hard for Sarah to find answers to her many questions.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jabal is in a tough situation because of Ali and Rima. Meanwhile, tension is brewing between Al Hayba and Tal Al Asfar.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Jabal pours his heart out to his mom. Meanwhile, Fares returns with unexpected plans as acts of revenge wreak havoc on Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jabal puts out the fire of the foggy, horrific night. Ali is held at gunpoint while Sameeh is surrounded by Jabal and his men.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: As Jabal and Fares’s relationship takes a turn, Ali prepares for his next step. Meanwhile, Shahin is oblivious of the consequences of his actions.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Jabal finds a visitor waiting for him with an important message. Meanwhile, shocking rumors about Jabal spread around in Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Sarah encourages Jabal to confide in her while Ali takes off on a journey to uncover the truth, bidding Rima farewell.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: While Sarah is forced to bid her farewell, unforeseen incidents wreak havoc on Al Hayba. Jabal stands on what seems to be the ruins of a heavy weapon shipment.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Sarah’s deepest secrets are revealed by an unlikely source. Meanwhile, Jabal scolds his men as Shahin’s relationship with Wadee’ worsens.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Abu Al Walid is alarmed by the disappearance of one of his men and later tasks Wadee’ with an important mission. Mona confides in Jabal.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Looking to reconcile with him, Wadee' pays Shahin a visit. Mona seeks a solution for the custody of her son while Jabal carries out a sensitive operation.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Abu Al Waleed gains Ali’s trust. Sarah resorts to Wadee’, who is the target of Jabal’s scheme. Al Shayeb and Al Sitt head towards Al Hayba.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: As Jabal strikes the gavel in Al Sett’s trial, Sarah ventures into the heart of the dam. Jabal makes a new discovery as his mother reminds him of his strength.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mona seeks common grounds with Shahin over the future of Ghazi. Wadee’ pours his heart out to Sarah, who detects something strange in the dam’s water.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: As a new shipment takes off with Ali aboard, Jabal keeps a close watch from the other side. Hoping that Shahin agrees to help him, Wadee’ plans Sarah’s escape.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jabal is torn between keeping Ali safe and stopping the final shipment. Tensions escalate as Shaheen discovers Wadee’s hidden intentions.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Jabal’s men prepare for the battle of life and death as new truths unfold before Jabal’s family. Meanwhile, Jabal arranges to meet the tribal leaders.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: As the critical battle approaches, leaders must unite to face a common enemy while Kilfaya suffers under the cruelty of Abu Al Waleed.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The people of Kilfaya take shelter in Al Hayba as it witnesses the most destructive of battles. A critical encounter brings Jabal and Wadee’ together.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Sultan’s house is empty and Jabal’s mom announces the start of the battle in Al Hayba. Wadee’ builds his final case against Jabal.
